intro-1: Today, Claude is starting a bus company in OpenTTD. Two hundred passengers, one hundred and twenty game days, and no extra borrowing.
intro-2: It starts with twenty thousand. By the end, it needs at least five thousand cash and a profitable fleet. Claude makes every decision.
outro-3: Claude met every target. 220 passengers delivered in 104 game days, with 5,627 cash left and a profitable bus fleet.
end-4: Would this company work better with two agents? We'll test collaboration in a later terrarium. Thanks for watching.
